blurb: Dance Innovations Dance Center offers dance classes for toddlers through adults, including ballet, tap, hip hop, acrobatics, contemporary, jazz, lyrical, modern, musical theatre, and cheer dance. Classes are leveled by age and experience, with options for recital participation and a dance team program. The studio maintains a dress code and has policies on attendance, cancellations, and payments.
extraNote: No refunds for lessons missed due to weather or power outages; makeup classes allowed · Students missing more than 4 classes without notice may be terminated from lessons · Tuition is paid in 10 equal monthly installments September through May by automatic payment · Costume deposit of $50 per class charged November 1; balances charged December 10 · Late payments after 10th of month incur 10% late fee; accounts unpaid over 45 days barred from class
